Do not claim site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecast, budget capacity, or causal lift.

Continue the existing launch-readiness evidence bundle and keep the private gate unchanged. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization; make no production, tracking, credential, configuration, monetization, or launch-state changes.

Preserve private launch gates; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.
